title: 300 Viral Intro Hook Patterns

content_classes.business: A company, professional practice, product, service, or named business speaker.
content_classes.ugc_creator: A creator producing relatable product, service, lifestyle, or demonstration content in a UGC style.
content_classes.influencer: A personality-led creator whose point of view, story, taste, or audience relationship is central.

usage: Use as an ideation and adaptation library. A hook pattern is not evidence that a claim is true or currently trending. Preserve approved client voice, proof, and compliance controls.

source.extraction_method: Rendered-page OCR with visual review for flagged rows
